reason: This function computes dispatch.report.price.discount by matching dispatch.lineItems[].id against discount.lineItemId. For return trips, dispatch line item IDs are suffixed with '#return' (by getDispatchLineItemKey upstream), so the equality check on line 17 never matches and discounts are never applied to return-trip dispatches — the exact bug.
fix: On line 17, change `(lineItem) => lineItem.id === discount.lineItemId` to `(lineItem) => parseDispatchLineItemKey(lineItem.id).id === discount.lineItemId`. Import `parseDispatchLineItemKey` from `~/services/helpers/order` (same module that already exports `getDispatchLineItemKey` used upstream). This strips the '#return' suffix before comparing, so return-trip dispatches correctly match their discounts.
